Configure this pitch

This is a reusable proposal preview. The starting example is Booster, six months, up to 20 participants. Programme content updates with the level. Use Pricing to configure daily rates, training days and optional services. Delivery dates and the final scope still require agreement.

Six items to resolve before finalisation

The presentation structure and design are ready to review. These content decisions remain open; no client results or commercial inclusions have been invented.

  1. Confirm the client and target cohortThe default is an illustrative six-month Booster proposal. Validate the business challenge and intended outcomes with the client.
  2. Agree the delivery commitmentThe default is two days per module at RM 10,500 per day. Confirm the actual days, module dates, orientation, graduation, coaching cadence and sponsor reviews for each package.
  3. Develop an evidence-based LDP caseOneSubsea and Insulet are identified as ongoing programmes. Add verified milestones and outcomes when available. Framework demonstrations are illustrative and must be aligned with the delivery team.
  4. Confirm faculty and credentialsThe faculty slide uses the supplied profiles. Confirm availability, programme assignment, headshots and individual accreditations before finalising.
  5. Confirm the commercial scopeTraining is priced at the user-confirmed daily rate. Optional fees start from editable source estimates. Confirm standard learning checks and reviews versus separately priced services, TalentValley fees, tax and quotation terms.
  6. Obtain logo and image permissionsOneSubsea and Insulet logos are reproduced from public media kits; obtain written consent for use in a client-facing proposal. Confirm the cover launch photograph is licensed for commercial use.

Salesperson Q&A

Why does this need several months?Explain the spacing between modules and the opportunity to practise at work. Avoid unsupported retention percentages. Show slides 9–11.
How much time will managers be away?Use the proposed schedule and agree classroom days explicitly. The default full programme is 12 training days; adjust selected modules and days in Pricing.
Can the content match our industry?Discuss workplace cases, participant challenges and sponsor priorities. Confirm any scope or fee changes in the quotation.
How will we know it worked?Agree baseline measures and observable behaviours before the programme. Explain who reports progress and when. Avoid guaranteeing causal business impact.
Is coaching included?Distinguish classroom feedback from separately priced executive or team coaching packages. Confirm the included allocation before quoting.
Can we claim through HRD Corp?The source template identifies the programme as claimable. Confirm the current programme registration, employer eligibility and claim process before promising an amount.
Why this programme level?Use current role and leadership responsibility, then validate with the sponsor. The four levels are audience tracks, not four mandatory consecutive courses.
Can you show a similar client's results?Use only an approved, comparable case. Until one is supplied, explain the evidence plan and be clear that portfolio logos do not prove LDP outcomes.

Build the client investment

RM 10,500 per training day for a cohort of up to 20, excluding SST. Two days per module is the preferred starting configuration. Optional-service rates are editable source-template estimates; confirm TalentValley scope and fees.
